cards.title: About GeoJSON Format
cards.body: GeoJSON is a JSON-based format for encoding geographic data. It's the standard format for web mapping libraries like Leaflet, Mapbox GL, OpenLayers, and Google Maps API.

cards.title: Why Convert FIT to GeoJSON?
items: Display tracks in web mapping applications
Use with Leaflet, Mapbox, or OpenLayers
Import into GIS software like QGIS
